panels.title: Queries per hour
panels.description: Request volume. Flat-lining here is the first sign the API stopped serving.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, count(*) AS queries
FROM query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: p95 separately from p50: a mean would hide the reranked tail.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95
FROM query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retrieval arm distribution
panels.description: Which arm actually served traffic — including fallbacks after degradation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arm AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY arm ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Feedback ratio
panels.description: Only rated answers. Unrated requests are absent rather than counted as neutral.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback = 'up')   AS thumbs_up,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback = 'down') AS thumbs_down
FROM query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND feedback IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Token usage / cost estimate
panels.description: Prompt and completion split — cost is dominated by whichever grows. cost_usd is 0 (and the field carries no data) unless LLM_PRICE_PER_1K_* is set.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time,
  sum(tokens_prompt)     AS prompt_tokens,
  sum(tokens_completion) AS completion_tokens,
  sum(cost_usd)          AS cost_usd
FROM query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Degraded-answer rate
panels.description: Share of answers served from a fallback path. The API returns 200 when a backend is down, so this — not the HTTP status — is how degradation is visible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time,
  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE degraded) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS degraded_pct
FROM query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
